entries.71efcbf8c992c4af: It states its basic philosophy as “Let’s enjoy growth,” and aims to create a setting where each individual can work with a sense of purpose while enjoying growth, and to realize a society in which everyone can work with vitality. In the HR-Related Business, it plans to expand direct services to end-client companies through call center dispatch, strengthen the use of women, senior citizens and global human resources, improve the functions of its core system and use AI for matching, and streamline clerical work through RPA. As issues to address, it cites the recruitment and training of dispatched staff, the securing and development of talented personnel, and the expansion of its revenue base, and states that it will provide comprehensive support for solving labor shortages through recruitment support and outsourcing businesses such as BPO, leveraging the knowledge developed in its staffing and placement business, and through its IT Solutions Business.
